chapter: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
act_title: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth

quests.title: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth

dialogue.t: Hm...
Hey, you two!
{NICKNAME}, Paimon, hello.
We're helping out Nefer with some expo stuff, and we heard the Krumkake Craftshop is taking part.
Correct. Aino is just doing a final round of debugging on her "Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots."
Oh, is that her submission for the expo?
Yes. Moles and other small creatures often steal from the Craftshop, so Aino designed a defense bot based off of them to protect this place.
Upon further testing, these bots turned out to be highly effective, so she decided to perform some upgrades and bring them to the expo.
Wait, so Aino is actually gonna trade one of her bots?
Not exactly. With the exception of a few special orders, Aino rarely sells her finished products. What she's trading at the expo is the blueprint, not the finished product.
Ohhh... So, are you guys ready to head over, then?
Jahoda asked us to speed things along a bit. She's saving a super good spot for you, and she's worried people are gonna start asking questions.
I told her I need to finish debugging first! There's no point in rushing or I'll have nothing to trade!
Whoa, Paimon's never seen Aino this serious before.
The Craftshop is experiencing a severe shortage of funds. Aino is hoping the expo will improve our financial situation, so she's being extra thorough.
Where'd all the money go? Some kind of expensive research?
Negative. It's our dessert funds that are lacking. We have had at least 47 cases where excess dessert purchases have led to a shortage of research funds.
As such, I decided to split up our research and dessert budgets. Aino is forbidden from dipping into one to transfer to the other.
And not too long ago, she cleaned out the entire dessert budget for this month.
Alright, done! Thwack 'n Whack Defense Bots, do me proud!
Looks like we can head over now.

dialogue.sit: You lead Aino and Ineffa to the venue.

dialogue.t: Hm... This looks like a good spot for the demo platform.
This new bot looks pretty interesting, Aino.
Hehehe! Swing by and try it out whenever you want! It'll blow your mind, I just know it!
Thanks for the help.
No problem! Oh, and for registration, is it just gonna be you two?
Hmm... I will be participating, but there is no need to register Aino. She doesn't like to be around a lot of people. Once the expo starts, she'll head straight back to the Craftshop.
Good point...

quests.description: Jahoda informs you that the booth reserved for Aino has been sitting empty for too long. You’d better get her here lickety-split.
